summary.text: Diane Wheatley is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 43 since 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A nurse by profession, she faces Democrat Janene Ackles in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Diane Wheatley was born in Fort Campbell, Kentucky, and graduated from 71st High School.
She earned an associate degree in nursing from Fayetteville Technical Community College and has worked as a nurse.
Wheatley assumed office on January 1, 2021, succeeding Elmer Floyd.
In the 2023-2024 session she chaired the Pensions and Retirement Committee and was vice chair of the Education - Community Colleges and Education - K-12 committees.
She advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026.
